unhinged ways to lock tf in
for school

1. dress like you study in a castle library

pyjamas say nap.
a blazer says thesis.

3. teach the lesson to your plants

explain it out loud.
if the cactus could follow, you understand it.

4. hide your phone in another room

the walk to get it is just long enough
to remember why you didn't.

5. swap scrolling breaks for learning breaks

before, my 5-minute breaks turned into an hour on my phone.
now i read one short page about history or art. and i actually go back to work.
